why.en: Yesterday's VAH (60,941.80), the opening-range high (60,956.34), the overnight and Asia high (60,842.45, same level) and the 00:00 NY day open (60,971.47) line up with a 15-minute bearish gap (61,127.93 to 61,444.00, double weight as it overlaps the short pocket) and the short pocket (60,970.16 to 61,257.00): confluence of 6 (profile level +1, overnight/IB-high/TDO pivot +1, gap +2, short pocket +1, Asia-session edge context +1; no multi-TF S/R point and no chop box edge, BTC isn't in a CHOP regime). The 24-hour move is flat: the method caps it at B always, it can't be A+ without going against the 24 hours.

trigger.en: A rejection in the 60,842.45 to 61,257.00 zone (yesterday's VAH, the opening-range high, the overnight/Asia high, the 15-minute bearish gap) with a 5-minute close back under 60,842.45.

reason.es: Sin GO: choque de precio activo (visto 14:40 UTC, -1.94% en 15 minutos) obliga como maximo WAIT durante la ventana de riesgo. La zona de compra (bolsillo dorado 60,280.38-60,577.18) ya se rompio sin rebote, paso su stop de invalidacion (60,240) y queda marcada rota; el precio sigue cayendo hacia el minimo de ayer (59,915). La zona de venta (60,842.45-61,257.00) queda lejos y sigue en B (techo de perfil, nunca A+ sin ir en contra de las 24 horas segun el metodo, no recalificada en este update). Conviccion baja: fondeo neutral, miedo extremo, choque de precio en marcha, checklist de tendencia recien pasado a largos reducidos sin confirmar en el marco mayor.
reason.en: No GO: an active price shock (seen 14:40 UTC, -1.94% in 15 minutes) caps the verdict at WAIT for the risk window. The buy zone (golden pocket 60,280.38 to 60,577.18) already broke with no bounce, traded past its invalidation stop (60,240) and is now marked broken; price keeps falling toward yesterday's low (59,915). The sell zone (60,842.45 to 61,257.00) is far away and stays at B (profile ceiling, never A+ without going against the 24 hours per the method, not re-graded in this update). Conviction stays low: neutral funding, extreme fear, an active price shock, and the trend checklist just moved to reduced longs without confirming on the higher frame.

counterCase.es: Si BTC cierra una vela de 15 minutos sobre 61,257.00 sin barrer primero, o bajo 60,280.38 sin reclamar, el balance se rompe de verdad y el siguiente imán seria el PDH (61,622.38) arriba o el PDL (59,915.00) abajo, con presupuesto de sobra (solo 12% del ATR diario usado). Cuentas largas de BTC en 2.47 a 1 todavia estan lejos del corte de riesgo de 3 a 1.
counterCase.en: If BTC closes a 15-minute candle above 61,257.00 without sweeping first, or below 60,280.38 without reclaiming, the balance truly breaks and the next magnet would be the PDH (61,622.38) above or the PDL (59,915.00) below, with plenty of budget left (only 12% of the daily ATR used). BTC's long-skewed accounts at 2.47 to 1 are still far from the 3-to-1 risk cutoff.

updated.es: El balance compacto del close se rompio con un choque de precio en los ultimos 15 minutos (BTC -1.94%, ETH -1.84%, visto 14:40 UTC) y cambio de regimen a bajista con ruptura grado A en las dos monedas. BTC perdio su bolsillo de descuento sin rebote y sigue cayendo hacia el minimo de ayer, tal como anticipaba el counterCase del close; esa zona queda marcada rota. ETH se mantiene dentro de su propia zona de no operar, ahora apoyado justo en el borde bajo de su bolsillo de compra tras barrer y reclamar el minimo de Asia, sin gatillo confirmado todavia. El movimiento de 24 horas (por velas) paso de plano a alcista en las dos, pero no se recalifica ninguna zona en este update ligero. Sin GO: el choque obliga como maximo WAIT en las dos.
updated.en: The close run's tight balance broke with a price shock in the last 15 minutes (BTC -1.94%, ETH -1.84%, seen 14:40 UTC) and a regime flip to bearish with a confirmed grade-A breakout on both coins. BTC lost its discount pocket with no bounce and keeps falling toward yesterday's low, just as the close plan's counter-case anticipated; that zone is now marked broken. ETH stays inside its own no-trade zone, now resting right at the lower edge of its buy pocket after sweeping and reclaiming the Asia low, with no confirmed trigger yet. The bar-based 24-hour move flipped from flat to positive on both, but no zone is re-graded in this light update. No GO: the shock caps both at WAIT.
